 Blue Raiders face WKU for Homecoming Saturday
 11/6/2026 11:00:00 AM | Football
 Share: By: @MTAthletics 
 Saturday, Nov. 7 | 2:32 p.m. | Floyd Stadium (27,303) | Murfreesboro, Tenn. 
 MIDDLE TENNESSEE 
 BLUE RAIDERS 
 4-4, 2-2 CUSA 
 VS 
 WKU 
 HILLTOPPERS 
 3-5, 2-2 CUSA 
 WATCH: ESPN+  | STATS: LINK | RADIO: WGNS ( LINK ) 
 GAME 9 
 » Saturday, Nov. 7 - 2:32 p.m. CT
» Floyd Stadium
» Murfreesboro, Tenn.
 SERIES HISTORY 
 » The oldest and most played series in Conference USA belongs to Middle Tennessee and WKU. The Hilltoppers own a slim 39-35-1 advantage in a series that began in 1914. WKU has won 10 of the last 11 meetings, including seven in a row. MTSU's last win in the series came in 2018 when they came away with a 29-10 home win. Overall, MTSU is 21-17-1 against WKU at home with the last win coming in 2018.
 BLUE RAIDER NOTES 
 » Dominic Bourgeois ranks 12th nationally in field goals made per game at 1.71
» Cam Lacy topped the 100 career reception mark last week and now has 103 to put him 21 back of 10th place all-time at MTSU.
» Santana Fleming ranks 11th nationally and 1st in CUSA in kickoff return average at 25.7
» The Blue Raiders have lost just six turnovers all season to rank 13th nationally and lead CUSA
» MTSU's last Homecoming win came in 2021 against Southern Miss.
» The 38 points scored against Murray State is the most put up in the Derek Mason era.
» The Blue Raider offense has committed just six turnovers in its last 11 games combined.
» MTSU's weather delay was 4:13 in win over Murray State and marked the third straight year the Blue Raiders have had a home game interrupted for weather. They had 2:40 delay in 2024 against TTU and a 2:12 delay against Marshall last year. That totals 9:05 in delays or right at 3 games.
» An emphasis for the Blue Raider offense in 2026 is to increase the amount of explosive plays (20 or more yards). In 2024 and 2025 combined, the offense had just 89 explosive plays with 45 coming last season. In 2026 they have 27 (8 vs Murray State, 5 vs FIU).
» MTSU has six coaches who have either played or coached at the NFL level ( Derek Mason , Brian Stewart , Calvin Lowry , Louie Cioffi, and Josh Smith).
» Consecutive Starts: Korey Smith 12, Roman Gagliano 11
» MTSU's last 1,000-yard rusher was Asher O'Hara in 2019 and he was a quarterback. The last running back to top 1,000 yards was I'Tavius Mathers in 2016.
» MTSU is one of just 12 schools in FBS to have a candidate on the Lou Groza and Ray Guy Watch Lists and the only Group of 6 team.
» The 2026 season for MTSU is the 112th for Blue Raider football and the 28th at the FBS level. 
 BLUE RAIDERS AT FLOYD 
 » Since Floyd Stadium opened in 1933, the Blue Raiders have compiled an overall mark of 314-146-13 (.678), including a record 31-game win streak from 1987-94. Since joining the FBS ranks in 1999, the Blue Raiders are 92-57 (.617) overall at Floyd Stadium and 59-33 in conference games (34-17 vs CUSA; 25-16 vs SBC). MTSU has a 48-28 (.632) record at home in its last 76 games.  
 BLUE RAIDERS ON HOMECOMING 
 » MTSU owns a mark of 55-29-2 all-time on Homcoming and are 15-12 since joining the FBS ranks in 1999. The Blue Raiders have a mark of 21-9-2 on Homecoming when played in the month of November but have not played Homecoming in the 11th month since 2008. 
 BOURGEOIS CHASING RECORD 
 »  Dominic Bourgeois , who ranks 28th nationally in field goal made percentage (.857), has connected on 12 of 14 three-pointers this season. The all-time single-season record is 18 set by Crews Holt (2018) and Alan Gendreau (2009). The 12 made field goals are the most by an MTSU kicker since Zeke Rankin hit 16 in 2022. He needs two more to equal the eighth most in a single-season. 
 BOURGEOIS HONORED FOR HUGE GAME 
 » PK Dominic Bourgeois , who was recently voted the CUSA Special Teams Player of the Week and a Lou Groza "Star of the Week", keyed MTSU's road win over FIU recently with 14 points, including four made field goals and two from 50 or more yards. The 14 points scored equaled the sixth most ever recorded in a single game at MTSU and is the most in a game since Crews Holt matched the record of 17 points scored against WKU in 2018 (t16th most by a kicker in FBS this season). Bourgeois' four made three-pointers equaled the third most in a game at MTSU while his two made from beyond 50 yards was a new school record. He is also just the ninth player in CUSA history to hit two 50-yard or longer kicks in the same game. 
 BLOCKS ARE BACK 
 » After going the first 29 games of the Derek Mason era without a blocked kick, the Blue Raiders recorded blocks in back-to-back games against Delaware and FIU. Redshirt junior outside linebacker Jayden Williams (6-6) was credited with the first blocked kick of his career when he rejected a Delaware PAT in the second quarter. It went down as the 76th blocked kick in MTSU's FBS era (since 1999) and the first blocked kick of any kind since 2023 when Jakobe Thomas rejected a PAT against LA Tech - a span of 35 games. At FIU, linebacker Ashton Taylor registered his first career block when he tipped an FIU field goal before halftime. It was the first blocked FG by MTSU since the 2022 season. MTSU is 10th nationally in blocked kicks entering WKU. 
 FORCING TURNOVERS 
 » After eight games, the Blue Raiders have done a good job in forcing and coming away with turnovers. MTSU enters the WKU game ranked T2nd in CUSA with 11 turnovers gained. The defense has registered five fumble recoveries and six interceptions. The team had 15 gained turnovers last year and are nearly to that mark in eight games. For the season, MTSU is +5 in turnover margin to rank 21st nationally and lead CUSA. 
 MARTIN PACING RUNNING ATTACK 
 » Running back Antonio Martin Jr. has been Mr. Impact for the Blue Raiders in 2026. In eight games for MTSU, Martin has notched four 100-yard rushing games with 103 against Murray State 104 in the win over Nevada, 106 at Jax State and 106 vs KSU. In 2025, MTSU had one back with two 100-yard games for the entire season. Entering the WKU game, Martin is third in CUSA in rushing yards per game (73.3) and fourth in rushing yards and fourth in yards per carry (5.23). Overall, MTSU has not had five 100-yard rushing games by the same player in a season since 2016 when I'Tavius Mathers had eight.
